crossRefs.note: The king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Cuthah
people.line: Babylonian city; origin of Samaritan settlers

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
